results.title: Air-conditioned suburban train services to be extended to Bangaon on India-Bangladesh border
results.description: Air-conditioned suburban train services to be extended to Bangaon on India-Bangladesh border Kolkata: The Sealdah Division of Eastern Railway (ER) will extend an air-conditioned EMU local train service up to Bangaon from August 20. The service that now runs between the Sealdah and Barasat stations will be extended up to Bangaon, officials said on Sunday. results.title: BGMI Lite India Launch Confirmed: Krafton to Release Lighter Version for Budget Phones Soon
results.description: Krafton has officially confirmed that BGMI Lite will launch in India by the end of 2026. According to a News18 report, the lighter version aims to make the popular battle royale title accessible to users with budget and entry-level smartphones, reducing hardware strain while retaining core gameplay features.
